sentence: Every Sunday evening she ____ her grandmother, partly to make sure the heating was working and partly just to hear her laugh.
meaning: 探望并问候（某人的近况）
note: check in on sb 指探望、过问近况；check out of 是结账离开，sign up for 是报名，look forward to 是期待，都不表看望老人。

sentence: Since the intern began working from home, her supervisor has ____ her twice a week to ask how the data entry is going.
note: check in on sb 指主动联系、过问某人的情况；tune in to 是收听节目，log on to 是登录系统，weigh in on 是就某议题插话发表意见（宾语应是议题），三者都不能以人作宾语。

sentence: The professor's two-minute explanation of compound interest ____ after a student posted it, and soon schools across the country were using it in class.
note: go viral 指内容被大量转发而走红；go blank 指屏幕或大脑空白，go missing 指失踪，go bankrupt 指破产，都不形容讲解在网上火了。

sentence: None of the editors expected the little clip of a cat stealing noodles to ____ overnight, yet by Monday it had been shared four million times.
note: go viral 指视频被大量转发；go steady 指固定交往，go bust 指倒闭，go astray 指走偏，都与两天内转发四百万次的爆火无关。

sentence: The folk songs my grandmother used to hum sounded old-fashioned at first, yet they slowly ____, and now I play them almost every evening.
meaning: 逐渐被某人喜欢上、被接受
note: grow on sb 指起初不喜欢、后来渐生好感；dawn on sb 是恍然大悟，wear on sb 是让人难熬，turn on sb 是转而攻击，后者都不合句意。

sentence: Although the beige wallpaper struck him as dreary at first, it has slowly ____, and he now refuses to let anyone repaint the room.
meaning: 逐渐赢得某人的好感与认可
note: grow on sb 表示看法由厌到喜；dawn on sb 只用于想明白某事，wear on sb 指令人渐觉难熬，turn on sb 指攻击，都与不准粉刷相悖。

sentence: After three exhausting sessions, the committee finally ____ a compromise that satisfied both the sports clubs and the library staff.
note: hammer out 指反复争论后敲定方案；make out 是辨认字迹，hold out 是坚持不让步，stand out 是显眼，都不能接 compromise。

sentence: The band spent most of the winter in a damp rehearsal room, trying to ____ the arrangement of each song before the tour began.
note: hammer out an arrangement 指反复商量、反复磨合后把编曲定下来；make out 是辨认字迹或声音，hold out 是坚持不让步，stand out 是显眼，都不能表示把编曲谈定。

sentence: Learning to juggle, she discovered, was pure ____ rather than talent: each dropped ball taught her where her hands should have been.
meaning: 反复尝试、从失败中摸索
note: trial and error 指反复试错摸索；ebb and flow 是涨落，give and take 是让步，ups and downs 指境遇起落，都不合学抛接。

sentence: The recipe in the old notebook lists no measurements at all, so anyone who follows it must rely on ____ and a good deal of luck.
meaning: 边试边改、从错误中找对方法
note: rely on trial and error 指边做边改；ebb and flow 是涨落，give and take 是让步，ups and downs 是起伏，与无用量无关。

sentence: Because the flat was freezing when she got home, she ____ the heating at once, then sat shivering under two blankets while the radiators slowly warmed up.
note: turn on 指打开电器或暖气；turn off 是关掉，与屋里很冷矛盾，turn over 是翻转，turn in 是上交，都不能接 the heating 表启动。

sentence: Whether the outdoor concert goes ahead will ____ the weather forecast, which currently promises heavy rain for Saturday.
note: 此处 turn on 意为取决于；turn off 是关掉或使人反感，turn into 是变成，turn up 是出现或调高，都不表视天气预报而定。

sentence: Careful fieldwork, ____ statistical modelling, gave the final-year survey a rigour that earlier student projects had clearly lacked.
note: couple A with B 指把两者结合，此处作过去分词；credited with 是被认为有，crowded with 是挤满，charged with 是被指控。

sentence: The new reading programme has been ____ a lighter homework load, which is exactly why so few parents have objected to it.
note: be coupled with 指与另一措施配套；be credited with 是功劳归于，be crowded with 是挤满，be charged with 是被指控。

sentence: It took the transfer student most of a term to ____ a class where almost everyone had known each other since primary school.
note: fit into 指融入新群体；fall into 指归入某类或陷入某状态，break into 指强行闯入，look into 指调查，都不能表被同学接纳。

sentence: With three lectures, a part-time job and a debating club, she wondered how the new volunteering scheme would ever ____ her timetable.
note: fit into 指把某事塞进已有日程；fit out 是配备设备，fit up 是安装器材，fit on 是试穿，都不能接 timetable 表安排日程。

sentence: Doctors warn that skipping breakfast regularly may ____ the body's ability to regulate blood sugar later in the day.
note: interfere with 后接事物，指妨碍其运作；interfere in 指插手争端事务，insist on 是坚持要求，result in 是导致结果。

sentence: The referee ruled that the defender had ____ the goalkeeper's attempt to catch the ball and awarded a free kick.
note: interfere with an attempt 指阻碍动作；interfere in 指插手他人事务，裁判所指即干扰扑救，insist on 与 result in 均不合。

sentence: Every morning millions of readers turn to the three-panel ____ that follows a hapless office clerk and his fat cat.
meaning: 报纸上分格连载的连环漫画
note: comic strip 指报刊分格连载的连环漫画；comic relief 是情节中的滑稽调剂，comic opera 是喜歌剧，comic verse 是诙谐诗。

sentence: For the class project, students were asked to turn a short story into a six-frame ____, using only drawings and a few captions.
meaning: 用连续画面讲故事的连环漫画
note: comic strip 指用连续几格图画讲故事；comic relief 是缓和气氛的段落，comic opera 与 comic verse 分别是喜歌剧和诙谐诗。

sentence: To explain the experiment quickly, the lecturer drew a ____ on the whiteboard, with two arms raised to show the magnetic field.
meaning: 用线条画成的人形（火柴人）
note: stick figure 指用简单线条画的人形，正好举手示意；stick insect 是竹节虫，stick shift 是手动挡，stick puppet 是木偶。

sentence: The animators first tested their software with a crude ____, a circle for a head and a line for each limb, before designing the film's real characters.
meaning: 圆圈头加线条四肢的小人
note: stick figure 是圆圈脑袋加线条四肢的小人；stick insect 是昆虫，stick shift 是挡位，stick puppet 是木偶，都解释不了这张草图。

sentence: In the last panel the character says nothing at all; the ____ above his head is completely empty, leaving readers to guess his reply.
meaning: 漫画里包住台词的对话框
note: speech bubble 指漫画里包住台词的对话框；soap bubble 是肥皂泡，bubble wrap 是包装膜，filter bubble 是信息茧房。

sentence: Beginners often stuff a ____ with long sentences, forgetting that real conversation rarely comes in neat paragraphs.
meaning: 漫画中写台词的对话框
note: speech bubble 指漫画中写台词的对话框，字数有限；soap bubble 一戳就破，bubble wrap 是包装膜，filter bubble 是信息茧房。
